# MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer v0.1.0-rc.1

## Release Status

This build is a **Release Candidate** intended for **evaluation only**.

> **Unsigned build warning:** The macOS packages are not code-signed or
> notarized. The Windows package does not include an Authenticode signature.
> Operating systems may display security or unknown-publisher warnings.

## Overview

MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer is a local-first desktop application for preparing
cloud billing data for FinOps analysis.

It supports:

- CSV/XLSX billing export preparation
- Local processing on the customer device
- Sensitive identifier protection

## Changes

- Release documentation alignment
- Public release preparation
- Public documentation boundary refinement

**No functional changes.**

## Supported Platforms

| Platform | Architecture | Package |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS | Apple Silicon (arm64) | `CloudDataSanitizer-macos-arm64.zip` |
| macOS | Intel (x64) | `CloudDataSanitizer-macos-x64.zip` |
| Windows | x64 | `CloudDataSanitizer-windows-x64.zip` |

## Security

- No cloud connection during sanitization
- No automatic upload
- No credential collection
- HMAC-SHA-256 Stable Pseudonymization for sensitive identifiers
- Local processing only

## Platform Warnings

- On macOS, use the standard Finder **Open** or **Privacy & Security** flow if
  you trust the downloaded checksum. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally.
- On Windows, SmartScreen may show **Unknown publisher**. Do not disable
  SmartScreen or antivirus protection globally.

## Verification

Release validation will verify:

- Platform artifacts
- Checksums
- Security metadata
- SBOM and provenance

This document does not claim that release validation is complete or that a
final release has been published.
